A VCR is distinct from its on-screen display, and physical buttons from on-screen PLAY. Audio media shape does not show sound, speed, or speaker identity. Analog color standards are metadata about country, period and signal, not mandatory palettes or noise. Separate frame address, burned-in display, date and VCR counter; backward motion needs multiple frames. Numbers-station audio, sender and purpose are separate; a radio and number notes are only circumstantial.)
